metadata.description: jr mods: Claude Code mods for solo builders. Context bar, plugin toggler, and more on the way.

plugins.name: jr-context
plugins.description: A context bar above the prompt: what fills the window, category by category, with a legend and the compaction point.

plugins.name: jr-mods
plugins.description: /jrmods: every installed plugin and mod in one list, in two tabs. Space ticks, Enter applies all changes at once.

plugins.name: jr-time
plugins.description: Billable time per project: session time sorted into categories, a ratio per category, an hourly rate and an amount. /jrtime, CSV and Markdown export.
